content: वज्र {%a.%} [वज्-रन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 28</ls>] .²1 Hard, adamantine. .²2 Severe. .²3 Forked, zigzag. .²4 Cross. .{@-ज्रः, -ज्रम्@} .²1 A thunderbolt, the weapon of Indra (said to have been formed out of the bones of the sage Dadhīchi <ab>q. v.</ab>); आशंसन्ते समितिषु सुराः सक्तवैरा हि दैत्यैरस्याधिज्ये धनुषि विजयं पौरुहूते च वज्रे <ls>Ś. 2. 16</ls>. .²2 Any destructive weapon like the thunderbolt. .²3 A diamond-pin, an instrument for perforating jewels; मणौ वज्रसमुत्कीर्णे सूत्रस्येवास्ति मे गतिः <ls>R. 1. 4</ls>. .²4 A diamond in general, an adamant; वज्रादपि कठोराणि मृदूनि कुसुमादपि <ls>U. 2. 7</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 19</ls>; मुक्तां मरकतं पद्मरागं वज्रं च विद्रुमम् <ls>Śiva B. 30. 12</ls>. .²5 Sour gruel. .{@-ज्रः@} .²1 A form of military array. .²2 A kind of Kuśa grass. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of various plants. .²4 A kind of pillar. .{@-ज्रम्@} .²1 Steel. .²2 A kind of talc. .²3 Thunderlike or severe language. .²4 A child. .²5 Emblic myrobalan. .²6 The blossom of the sesamum or {%Vajra%} plant. .²7 Denunciation in strong language. .²8 A particular posture in sitting.
